author: wrorm6779
what_it_is: Three different sets of saves on the one file. Each Game level has two saves. The first two are the regular game and the other two sets are next fear game saves.
format: DexDrive .gme: '123-456-STD' 3904-byte header (per-block comments) + 131072-byte raw card; the card holds 1 save(s), 1 for this game (BASLUS-00707SILENT00)
